verdict.rationale: The public MCP endpoint is served under a versioned path (/api/app/public/v1/mcp), and the CLI commits to a stable --json shape with additive-only changes. That is a compatibility commitment, but it covers CLI output rather than the API. No deprecation policy, sunset timeline or version-migration guidance is documented. missing for 10: documented API deprecation policy, explicit API versioning scheme and compatibility guarantees for the API itself, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP.
`--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
